name: google-my-business
label: Google My Business
description: Publish posts and reply to reviews on Google Business Profile.

get-location.label: Get Location
get-location.description: Gets the details of a business location.

location_id.label: Location ID
location_id.description: The location id, e.g. 456 or locations/456. Get it from the name field returned by List Locations (list-locations).

update-location.label: Update Location
update-location.description: Updates the website, labels or store code of a business location.

location_id.label: Location ID
location_id.description: The location id, e.g. 456 or locations/456. Get it from the name field returned by List Locations (list-locations).

website_uri.label: Website
website_uri.description: The public website URL of the business.

labels.label: Labels
labels.description: Internal labels for the location. Replaces the existing labels. Leave empty to keep the current labels; this action cannot clear them.

store_code.label: Store Code
store_code.description: Your internal identifier for the location.

get-location-verification-state.label: Get Location Verification State
get-location-verification-state.description: Gets whether a location is verified and can publish changes.

location_id.label: Location ID
location_id.description: The location id, e.g. 456 or locations/456. Get it from the name field returned by List Locations (list-locations).

get-media.label: Get Media
get-media.description: Gets one photo or video of a location.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: The account id, e.g. 123 or accounts/123. Get it from the name field returned by List Accounts (list-accounts).

location_id.label: Location ID
location_id.description: The location id, e.g. 456 or locations/456. Get it from the name field returned by List Locations (list-locations).

media_id.label: Media ID
media_id.description: The media key: the last segment of the name field returned by List Media (list-media).

get-review.label: Get Review
get-review.description: Gets one customer review of a location.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: The account id, e.g. 123 or accounts/123. Get it from the name field returned by List Accounts (list-accounts).

location_id.label: Location ID
location_id.description: The location id, e.g. 456 or locations/456. Get it from the name field returned by List Locations (list-locations).

review_id.label: Review ID
review_id.description: The reviewId field returned by List Reviews (list-reviews), or the full review name.

reply-to-review.label: Reply to Review
reply-to-review.description: Creates or replaces the owner reply to a review.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: The account id, e.g. 123 or accounts/123. Get it from the name field returned by List Accounts (list-accounts).

review_id.label: Review ID
